title: A two-dimensional qutrit input extends positive coherent information
summary: A numerical search found an input for the qutrit depolarizing channel that the author reduced to a uniformly mixed state on two of its three levels. An interval calculation placed the zero of its coherent information near 0.2910672 in the channel’s mixing parameter. The full three-level mixed input’s hashing point is about 0.287087.
ai_technology: Claude Sonnet 5.5; Infinity Machine research agent

source_review.scope: Zenodo v1 interval-certificate note metadata; Infinity Machine §3.2 and Appendix A.2; earlier qudit capacity study

evidence.tested: The author derived a single-use formula for the rank-two input and numerically certified the zero. Positive coherent information gives an achievable lower bound on capacity.
evidence.unknown: The reported point is a lower bound rather than an optimal capacity threshold. The author notes that the observation may be previously known and makes no priority claim.
evidence.ai_role: A Claude Sonnet 5.5 proposer ran a numerical search that found a two-qutrit state. The human operator identified its factorization into two rank-two single-use inputs and supplied the closed-form analysis.
